Intro: Hello… hello chef. Your restaurant is looking lovely. Svetka has made the rest of the city miserable, but at least in here I can pretend.
I have always been pretending, I think. I was offered a residence in the palace, once, on account of… I was favored, there.
And I refused, because I wanted to distance myself as far as possible from the repulsive amount of waste bleeding from every pore of that place.
I refused because it would be wrong.
I feel stupid. I may as well have accepted. I think…. I think I will talk to Nadezdha. And then I will quit.
